mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates aggressive monetary accommodation that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as capital costs decline.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Joint decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below 12-month averages indicates weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns due to reduced corporate revenue expectations over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are below 12-month averages.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 indicates constrained manufacturing output that increases price pressures and profit margins, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS exceeding 0.5% per annum signals active monetary tightening that increases corporate borrowing costs and reduces equity valuation multiples, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 above 2.0% YoY) indicates robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE above 5.0%) creates a negative feedback loop where reduced consumer spending lowers retail sales and corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Joint decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) below 6-month averages signals systemic supply chain disruption that reduces manufacturing output and increases input costs, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both INDPRO and HOUST are below 6-month averages.
